card.name: Completing 'parenteral' and 'orally administered'
card.fires_on: The ending 'eral' of 'parenteral' in aluminum-toxicity warnings, and 'administered' right after 'orally' in drug interaction lists.

modes.label: parenteral ending
modes.description: The final piece 'eral' after 'parent' in aluminum exposure warnings for neonates.
modes.example: who receive parent<<eral>> levels of aluminum at greater than 4

modes.label: orally administered
modes.description: The word 'administered' right after 'orally' before a drug name such as midazolam.

card.plain: It lights up when a route-of-administration term like parenteral or orally administered is being completed.
